provenance.source: OpenGrokVersion/OpenGrokCLI semantics vs Rust xai-grok-version + xai-grok-config path resolution
evidence: OPEN_GROK_VERSION moved from 0.1.220-open-grok.58 at 650c1db7 to 1.0.0-open-grok.81 at historical baseline 538a16df, then advanced to 1.0.0-open-grok.82 in release commit b962dfa6; the marker, build plugin, checked-in generated source, CLI output, and distribution baseline all agree on .82.

Commit 00e176c8 keeps OPEN_GROK_VERSION at .82 while moving immutable build identity into xai-grok-version::BuildInfo and registering it at xai-grok-pager-bin/src/main.rs:1692-1697 before telemetry, argument parsing, doctor, or version dispatch.

xai-grok-version/src/lib.rs:15-145 defines local/release identity, permits identical registration, rejects conflicts, retains standalone package fallbacks, and deliberately classifies an uninitialized optimized process as release-shaped so folder trust fails closed.

install.sh:35-53 now accepts Darwin arm64/aarch64, Linux x86_64/amd64, and Linux aarch64/arm64; scripts/build-linux-release.sh:9-26 publishes GNU x86_64 and aarch64 binaries with install.sh and SHA-256 sidecars.

xai-grok-config/src/paths.rs added explicit-home helpers and owner-only session directories, but default_grok_home() still resolves <home>/.opengrok and grok_home() still prefers $OPENGROK_HOME.
